source_policy.eligibility_scope: Fixed slots, native identities/text, level-dependent values, destroyed-spike activation requirements, other-style group gate and same-group attribute merge metadata. Triggered buffs and final combat formulas remain unresolved.

contract.identity: Use guardian_id, never name alone. Same-name style/form records are distinct.
contract.roster: Current named style/form records: flags_fc bit 4 set and style mask 1/2. This is a capture-specific classification. Native UI also checks ownership at RVA 0x374BD8; bit 4 alone is not an unlock or universal selectability proof.
contract.level_index: Arrays are indexed directly by native guardian-level input 0..100. Available growth rows do not prove legal maximum guardian level.
contract.activation_threshold: Required destroyed Crucible Spike count (native Chinese: 地狱之楔破坏数). Native RVA 0x375364 uses unsigned u16 >=. This is separate from guardian level.
contract.other_style_guardian: Other-style effects require native effect group 0x8508 (双灵庇佑); native getter result must be signed nonnegative. Its description explicitly enables both styles. Native set membership/piece requirement remains pending.
contract.same_group_merge: Use native group IDs and aggregation metadata. Numeric duplicates sum with optional native raw cap; grade duplicates retain best raw rank and add one rank step per duplicate. Live numeric evidence is scoped to 57 luck updates; grade rule is native control flow only.
contract.hidden_values: Raw values are retained even when the native formatter displays no number. They are not inferred buff strength or duration.
remaining_semantics: native set-to-effect join and piece requirement for group 0x8508
triggered buff strength, duration, refresh/overwrite and final combat formulas
